Casa Amor

8 Bedrooms 8 Full Bathrooms 1 Half Bathrooms 22 Sleeps Seagrove Beach

Home Highlights
- Brand New Construction
- Large gated private pool
- Elevator
- 6 seater Golf Cart & 6 adult Bikes
- Game Room
- Rooftop Fireplace

Set in the heart of Seagrove and just moments from the sugar-white sand, this newly constructed luxury retreat offers an elevated 30A experience with every detail designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable coastal living. Thoughtfully designed with a spacious main home and private carriage house, the property is ideal for families and groups seeking both refined accommodations and room to spread out.
Behind a gated entrance, guests can enjoy a large private pool, beautifully designed indoor and outdoor living spaces, and upscale amenities throughout. From effortless access via the elevator to evenings spent by the rooftop fireplace, every space invites relaxation after a day at the beach. The home also features a game room for added entertainment, along with a 6-seater golf cart and six adult bikes for exploring Seagrove, Seaside, and the surrounding 30A favorites with ease.
Perfectly positioned within walking distance to the beach and Seaside, this exceptional Seagrove getaway blends brand-new luxury, prime location, and resort-style amenities for a truly memorable stay on 30A.
